$schema_note: F39 versioned platform strategy + capability profiles (program social-planner-september-eighth, SPEC platform strategy matrices S15-S23). One machine-readable entry per supported platform. The human-readable creative guidance lives in references/platform-strategies/<platform>.md. checked_at records when the profile was last verified against official sources. organic vs advertising guidance is SEPARATED everywhere. A verified profile version is recorded in every content contract (profile_version + checked_at).

policy.stale_behavior: A profile whose checked_at is older than stale_after_days triggers a refresh task; until the refresh succeeds, the LAST VERIFIED SAFE profile continues to be used (never blocks other channels; never publishes unverified strategy as fact).
policy.unsupported_feature_policy: A native feature not supported through the active GHL adapter presents the approved supported variant, or marks that one capability unavailable — it never blocks other channels and never silently drops the destination.

instagram.organic_guidance_summary: Original brand-relevant creative; match the idea to a carousel, image or Reel; opening visually clear, captions legible, vertical safe areas intentional. Watch time #1; DM shares and saves critical. Consult the account's professional-dashboard recommendations.
instagram.advertising_guidance_summary: Separate lane: paid placement follows Meta ads guidance; organic learnings must not be presented as paid results.
instagram.timing_policy: Test timing with this audience via native analytics; no universal best hour.

tiktok.source_label: S16 TikTok Creative Codes (ad guidance; organic transfer is a proposed test, not guaranteed)
tiktok.organic_guidance_summary: Vertical 9:16 video: immediate hook, useful body, clear close; motion, native-feeling delivery, captions, appropriately licensed audio.
tiktok.advertising_guidance_summary: Creative Codes vertical framing, hook/body/close and sound principles originate in TikTok AD guidance — cite as ad-derived creative principles, never as promised organic results.
tiktok.timing_policy: Compare watch time and completion; do not promise ad results organically.

linkedin.organic_guidance_summary: Lead with professional relevance and a concrete insight or evidence; custom visuals, native video or document storytelling when the delivery path supports it; invite useful discussion. Never copy Instagram captions unchanged.
linkedin.advertising_guidance_summary: Separate lane: sponsored content follows LinkedIn Ads guidance; organic engagement is not ad performance.
linkedin.timing_policy: Test post timing; evaluate relevant engagement and clicks.

facebook.organic_guidance_summary: Original useful posts and Reels for the actual community; clear visuals and substantive context; avoid low-value repost transformations and engagement bait.
facebook.advertising_guidance_summary: Separate lane: boosted/ad creative follows Meta ads guidance.
facebook.timing_policy: Assess reach and responses from native insights; no universal cadence.

pinterest.organic_guidance_summary: Mobile-friendly visual ideas; 2:3 image is the sound starting format; accurate searchable titles/descriptions; relevant destination link; plan for seasonal discovery.
pinterest.advertising_guidance_summary: Separate lane: promoted pins follow Pinterest Ads guidance.
pinterest.timing_policy: Evaluate saves and outbound clicks over a suitable observation window.

x.organic_guidance_summary: Concise central message with relevant media; threads only where they add value AND the adapter supports them; participate in useful conversations under the client's interaction policy.
x.advertising_guidance_summary: Separate lane: X Ads follows X's own guidance.

youtube.organic_guidance_summary: Title and thumbnail match the actual video; promised value established early; achievable consistent schedule; learn from audience retention. Do not claim an exact upload time guarantees long-term performance.
youtube.advertising_guidance_summary: Separate lane: YouTube ads guidance governs paid promotion.
youtube.timing_policy: Review retention and CTR separately; no guaranteed upload-time effect.

google-business-profile.organic_guidance_summary: Accurate updates, offers or events with complete details, dates and a useful action; appropriate real brand/product imagery; omit stale promotions.
google-business-profile.advertising_guidance_summary: Separate lane: Google Ads (Local Services, Performance Max) is distinct from GBP posts.
google-business-profile.timing_policy: Validate offer/event expiry and destination links before production.

ghl_unsupported_native_features: all — verify active GHL support before any production
threads.organic_guidance_summary: Original conversational posts with context and relevant topics; thoughtful replies when interaction is authorized; avoid automated generic replies or copying another platform blindly.
threads.advertising_guidance_summary: No advertising lane — Threads organic only.
threads.timing_policy: Evaluate replies and views where available.
